scope: Development smoke corpus, not held-out or production accuracy. No capability executes. Prompt sections and schemas come from the real Banana extensions.
recipeNote: MiniCPM5 2B native MLX no-thinking supported template setting, XML parser; vendor 1.0/.95, native min_p default0, unspecified top_k disabled. No extra repetition penalty unless looping observed.

settings.budgetMeaning: Checkpoint preflight only; working memory is observed, not hard-limited by this option
settings.contextEnforcement: Fixture inputs/output bound; standalone server has no matching max-context flag
settings.cachePolicy: One retained prompt cache, 2GB cap; different implementation from Locals slots
settings.serverSeed: Per-request seed=0; standalone API rather than Locals server-global RNG
